data.description: newest first; days without usage omitted

retained.description:
Retained[k] is the percentage (0-100, 2 decimals) of the cohort active
k weeks after its first week; only weeks that have started are listed.

approximation.description:
Approximation is "day": step order is resolved per UTC day, so steps
done on the same day count as in order.

property_schema.description: PropertySchema is an optional JSON Schema subset (type/properties/required).

slug.description: Slug defaults to the snake_case form of name.

is_predefined.description: IsPredefined mirrors is_global (Laravel field name), read-only.

tenant_id.description: TenantID is null for platform-global types.

category_id.description: CategoryID: a uuid sets it, null clears it.

property_schema.description: PropertySchema: an object replaces it, null clears it.

slug.description: Slug is immutable; sending the current value is accepted.

secret.description: Secret is shown once; LevelUp stores only its hash.

status.description: pending | expired (lists show open invitations only)

password_confirmation.description: PasswordConfirmation is optional; when sent it must match.

config.description: Config is required for type activity and refused for every other.

criteria.description:
Criteria grammar: {"event_type": "...", "where": [{"field", "operator", "value"}],
"increment": {"by": "count"} | {"by": "property", "field": "..."}}.
With event_type, matching activities progress the mission automatically.

duplicate.description:
Duplicate is true when the Idempotency-Key was already applied: the
increment was not counted again.

schedule.description: Schedule: {starts_at?, ends_at?, days_of_week?: [0-6], hours?: {from: "HH:MM", to: "HH:MM"}, timezone?: IANA}.

stopped_by.description: StoppedBy is the rule whose firing skipped this one (status skipped_by_stop).

draft.description: Draft is true when definition was simulated instead of the live ruleset.

history_loaded.description:
HistoryLoaded is true when history.* facts came from the player's
recorded activity (stored players only; inline players have none).

count_estimate.description:
CountEstimate is the number of matching players among the first
Scanned players (ascending id, at most 1000). Exact when Complete.

auto_record.description:
AutoRecord (default true): activities whose event_type equals
activity_key record a period automatically.

occurred_at.description: defaults to now; decides the period bucket

outcome.description:
Outcome: recorded (new period), noop (period already recorded) or
duplicate (Idempotency-Key replay).
